title: Mission 1: Supply Ship Attack: North of Scotland
objective: Destroy the Merchant Ship before it exits the map, then exit the map in the direction of the red arrow.

phases.name: U-Boat Phase
phases.header_text: If Medium, DL -1   |   If Deep, DL -2

sections.text: Roll 3 dice (2 dice if Engine is Damaged); AP this turn = highest die rolled + 1 AP if Captain is alive

rows.comment: Can only enter a ship's hex if Medium/Deep. Can only enter land or shallow hexes if Surfaced or at Periscope depth.
Turn 1 hex edge left or right.
Once per turn, one level only. Cannot go below Periscope in shallows or above Medium underneath a ship.
Remove 1 damage marker, or fix up to 2 Torp tubes (Hull cannot be repaired). Only Surface repairs if Engineer is KIA. Flak and Deck Gun repairs only when Surfaced.
At Ships in LoS (R1-3). Roll 2d6: 7+ to Hit at R1-2, 8+ to Hit at R3. On Hit, set DL to 3 and roll on Allied Ship Damage Chart.
Load 2 tubes; 1 if Weapons Officer is KIA.
Fire 1-3 Torpedoes (R1-9). Roll d6 per Torp. If Fire 3, DL +1. Target first ship along line of fire. Missed torps continue to other Ships beyond.

sections.title: Torpedo Attack
notes: If Fire 3 torpedoes, DL +1. If any hit, DL +1.
Target first ship along line of fire. Missed torpedoes continue to other ships beyond.

sections.title: Allied Ship Damage Chart (for each Torpedo / Deck Gun Hit on a Ship, roll d6)
FIRE TORPS
notes: Target first ship along line of fire. Missed torpedoes continue to other ships beyond.
If Fire 3 torpedoes, DL +1. If any hit, DL +1.

sections.title: Allied Ship Damage Chart (for each Torpedo / Deck Gun hit on a Ship, roll d6 for damage)

sections.text: If Undamaged: MOVE 1 hex. If Damaged: roll 1d6; on 4+ MOVE 1 hex. Always face dotted line direction.
Roll a d6 for each Escort which has the U-Boat in LoS and within 3 hexes. Each success = +1 DL.

phases.name: Escorts Phase
phases.header_text: Activate closest first (you choose for ties). Resolve dice in order.

cells: If DL = 1–3: FIRE or DEPTH CHARGE
If blocked, TURN   |   If DL = 1–3: DEPTH CHARGE
If blocked, TURN   |   If DL = 1–3: DEPTH CHARGE

sections.text: DEPTH CHARGE: If U-Boat is not Surfaced and is at Range 0–1, roll 1d6 on U-Boat Damage Chart (Destroyer: 2d6, take lowest).

TURN: If DL = 0–1, turn 1 hex edge towards Anchor. If DL = 2–3, turn 1 hex edge towards U-Boat. If facing U-Boat/Anchor, only turn if blocked (turn randomly). If facing away, turn randomly. If on same hex as U-Boat/Anchor, only turn if blocked (turn randomly).
FIRE: If U-Boat is Surfaced, in LoS and at Range 1–3, set DL to 3 and roll as a Critical Hit on U-Boat Damage Chart below.
MOVE 2 hexes. Remove B24 if it exits the map. If DL = 2–3, TURN 1 hex edge in direction of U-Boat. If facing U-Boat, do not turn. If facing away, turn randomly.

ATTACK (R0–1): If U-Boat Surfaced or Periscope depth and Flak Gun undamaged & U-Boat surfaced, roll 2d6: destroy B24 on 7+ if Lookout is alive. If B24 survives, roll 1d6: 1–2 +2 Hull Damage, 3–4: roll on U-Boat Damage Chart below, 5–6: Miss.

sections.title: U-Boat Damage Chart (Depth Charge, Ship Gun Fire and B24 Aircraft attacks)

cells: Critical Hit: U-Boat Destroyed   (+2 Hull Damage)   3–4: Torp tubes 3d6   5–6: Damage × 2 (roll twice at 3–4 below)
Damage: Roll 1d6. 1: +1 Hull Damage, 2: Flak gun, 3: Torp tubes 2d6, 4–5: Engine, 6: Deck gun (no effect if already damaged).
Crew KIA: Roll d6 for Crew member (no effect if already KIA). If Medic is alive, roll d6 to avoid KIA on 5+.
If DL = 2–3: place B24 facing U-Boat, on edge hex of map which is furthest from and on same hex-line as U-Boat (mission-specific text).
Escort Detection: If DL is not already at 3, perform Phase 3 (Detection Phase) again now.
If U-Boat is Surfaced or at Periscope depth, radio intercepted by Allies: If DL = 0 then set DL to 1.
Hull Pressure: If Deep, Hull groans under the pressure: +1 Hull Damage (U-Boat must ascend to Medium depth).
If U-Boat not Surfaced and Engine is not damaged, U-Boat runs silently for a while: -1 DL.

global_notes.title: Ship Movement and Forced Dive
text: Ships cannot enter a hex with another Ship. 'Blocked' = Land, off-map or another Ship.
If a Ship enters a hex with Surfaced or Periscope depth U-Boat, it is Forced to Dive to Medium: DL +1 now, and -2 AP next turn.
Hull Damage: U-Boat immediately ascends to permitted depth. If it cannot Dive/Ascend as required here, it is Destroyed.
